_comment: Frozen per-file max-lines ceilings — the size-ratchet baseline (code-quality-architecture-1 + -3). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: eslint.config.js generates a per-file `max-lines` override from each entry (replacing the old `max-lines: off` grandfathers, which allowed UNBOUNDED growth — pulseKernel grew +28% before this froze it), and tests/lint/sizeBaseline.test.js keeps this map HONEST. Every value is the file's CURRENT effective line count (eslint max-lines, skipBlankLines+skipComments) frozen 2026-07-16. SHRINK-ONLY: to shrink a file, LOWER its number here (the win is then locked); a file that grows past its number REDS eslint; a file that falls under its LAYER ceiling (600 components/src-root-jsx, 800 everywhere else) must have its entry DELETED (the house test demands it). Never RAISE a number and never ADD a file without a decomposition-is-infeasible reason — these are burn-down candidates, not a licence to grow. Keys are repo-relative paths. This _comment key is ignored by both consumers.
_wr7b_rebaseline_2026_08_03: R-BLD-6 (chair ruling, WR-7b): the WR-7b pre-build ruling row in docs/FABLE_VALIDATION_QUEUE.md banks this debt verbatim — 'Broad gate/typecheck/exact-line/file-budget/overhead debt remains banked for the terminal consolidated adversarial review.' This file IS that bank, so the banked ruling is recorded here mechanically instead of being bypassed at the hook. Measured 2026-08-03 with eslint's own Linter under the enforcer's rule: 18 files exceeded their layer ceiling at HEAD eea5a6c6 while only 12 were baselined — the ratchet had been broken repo-wide for several waves because lint-staged lints only STAGED files, so a lane that never stages an over-ceiling file commits happily past a red ratchet. RE-FROZEN at measured tree size: applyWorldPulse 903->1395 (1388 of that is inherited at HEAD; WR-7b contributed +7), pulseKernel 1362->1580 (byte-identical to HEAD; WR-7b contributed 0), warDeployment 1106->1412 (byte-identical to HEAD; WR-7b contributed 0). NEWLY ENTERED at measured tree size: envoyErrand 2638 (1389 inherited, +1249 WR-7b), peaceTerms 1680 (1289 inherited, +391 WR-7b), roadsKernel 838 / settlementStrategy 812 / warTermination 880 (all three byte-identical to HEAD, 100% inherited). eventProse was an offender at HEAD (1334) and is deliberately ABSENT: WR-7b decomposed it to 751, under its ceiling, so the layer rule now guards it — the wave shrank the offender set from 18 to 17. THIS IS A BURN-DOWN LEDGER, NOT A LICENCE: every entry above the pre-WR-7b frozen number is debt owed to THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE, which must lower each number toward its layer ceiling and delete the entry when it crosses. Nothing here may ever be RAISED again outside an explicit chair ruling of this kind.
_decomposition_wave_laneD_2026_08_03: THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE, lane D (non-war tranche) burns down the entries the R-BLD-6 ruling above banked. Each file listed here is decomposed by behaviour-identical pure-leaf extraction (the WR-7b pattern: the head keeps its writer/entry role, the leaves carry the moved bodies verbatim), golden-pinned byte-identical BEFORE the ratchet moves, then its number is LOWERED to the new measured count — or its entry DELETED when it crosses under the layer ceiling and the layer rule takes over. DELETED by lane D: src/domain/display/causeConjunctionRoleContent.js (3890 -> 26; the twelve authored role blocks moved verbatim to src/domain/display/causeConjunctionRole/<role>.js, 324 effective lines each; the assembled ROLE_CONTENT is byte-identical and identically shallow-frozen); src/generators/historyGenerator.js (826 -> 655; generateSafetyNarrative2 + generateTradeNarrative2 + their sole reader priorityMult moved verbatim to src/generators/history/historyEventStrands.js, 173 effective lines, same-seed golden master byte-identical); src/store/aiSlice.js (829 -> 757; the dossier-notes + pinned-NPC lane to src/store/aiDossierPinActions.js and the chronicle append + tier rotation to src/store/aiChronicleAppend.js, both by the settlementPendingEditActions delegation idiom — the slice keeps every action KEY so the slice literal stays the census surface, only the bodies move); src/pdf/lib/viewModel.js (998 -> 698; the four settlement-body chapters economics/defense/services/resources to src/pdf/lib/viewModelBodySlices.js, and the three readers the head and that leaf BOTH need — stressArray, foodCore, avgScore — to src/pdf/lib/viewModelPrimitives.js, which neither imports, so the split is cycle-free; two structural pins that read viewModel.js BY FILENAME were re-anchored onto the whole src/pdf/lib/viewModel*.js module set so a relocation can neither break them nor silently un-guard them). RATCHETED-DOWN, NOT DELETED, by lane D: src/store/settlementSlice.js (1226 -> 994; the module-level lifecycle helpers — _dimsSummary, the derived-config strip, rippleEventThroughWorld, activateFaithIfEntitled and the resetSettlementIdentity chokepoint — to src/store/settlementLifecycleHelpers.js, and the recordSnapshot / revertToSnapshot bodies to src/store/settlementVersionHistoryActions.js by the delegation idiom; whole store suite green 1060/1060). DELIBERATELY DEFERRED — documented, not a bug to re-find: the remaining 194 lines over the ceiling are the generation lane (generateSettlement + regenSection, ~330 effective) and the canon-event lane (applyEvent + undoLastEvent). The generation lane is NOT a like-for-like move: it closes over the module-local memoized loadEngine(), so extracting it relocates a LAZY chunk boundary and must be re-proved against the first-paint byte-budget build tests (tests/build/vendorPdfLazy.test.js, engineChunkLazy) with a real build — out of scope for a cycle that could not run one. A lane-D continuation should take that pair next, with the build gate, and delete this entry.
_decomposition_wave_war_2026_08_03: THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE, WAR TRANCHE — the other half of the burn-down the R-BLD-6 ruling above banked, same method as lane D with one addition the cycle-8 verifier demanded: BEHAVIOR-IDENTITY IS PROVED BY STRIPPED-BLOCK DIFF, not by tests alone. Every top-level declaration of the pre-split module is parsed out with its comments stripped and its `export ` prefix normalized, keyed by name; the split is accepted only when the pre-split map EQUALS the union of the family's maps — same key set, byte-identical bodies. A reorder inside a function, a changed constant or a dropped guard all red; moving a declaration between files does not, which is exactly the change being made. Each split is ALSO strict-NEUTRAL per R-BLD-9: the per-file strict map is measured before and after, the family total must be unchanged, and no debt may land on a non-family file. DELETED by the war tranche: src/domain/worldPulse/envoyErrand.js (2638 -> 691, file 1 @ 42299b07 — one head, nine leaves, the single-writer law made structural); src/domain/worldPulse/peaceTerms.js (1680 -> 765, file 2 — one head keeping the mover advanceTreaties, BOTH treaty mints and the one authority-clock boundary materializeCarriedTermSheet, over nine pure leaves catalog/primitives/appraisal/drafting/carriedSheet/graph/coalition/overlay/document; 77/77 declarations byte-identical, all 39 exports still exported from the head so no consumer import path moved, family strict total 48 before and 48 after). The two remaining war entries — pulseKernel and applyWorldPulse — are THE PULSE MOUTHS and carry an extra law: the kernel's stage ORDER and stream identity may not move, since any reordering is a same-seed shift.
